# CardContent

Content area of card

## Overview

- **Category**: surfaces
- **Base Library**: mui
- **MUI Component**: CardContent

## Installation

```bash
npm install @lsy-netline/netline-ui
```

## Import

```typescript
import { CardContent } from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui';
```

## Basic Usage

```tsx
<CardContent>
  <Typography variant="h5">Title</Typography>
  <Typography>Content</Typography>
</CardContent>
```

## Examples

```tsx
<CardContent>
  <Typography variant="h5">Title</Typography>
  <Typography>Content</Typography>
</CardContent>
```

## MUI Reference

This component is based on Material-UI's CardContent.

For additional props and detailed API documentation, refer to:

- [MUI CardContent Documentation](https://mui.com/material-ui/api/cardcontent/)
